c11_acc_cbse_01_001: It's easy to think every important business event gets recorded — but accounting only records what can be measured in money. Check: can you price it in rupees?
c12_acc_cbse_01_001: Sharing profits alone doesn't make a partnership — a lender or employee can share profits too. Check for mutual agency and a business being carried on.
c11_acc_cbse_01_002: Book-keeping records what happened; accounting explains what it means. If you're analysing why margin fell, that's accounting — posting a ledger isn't.
c12_acc_cbse_01_002: The partnership deed isn't just a formality — interest on capital, salaries and goodwill rules all flow from it. Read the deed before any appropriation entry.
c11_acc_cbse_01_003: Accounting didn't improve in one straight line — each region built it for local needs. Pacioli's leap was a universal dual-aspect frame, not a 'better' system.
c12_acc_cbse_01_003: Don't assume profits follow the capital ratio — without a deed, partners share equally and get no interest on capital or salary. Check the deed first.
c11_acc_cbse_01_004: 'Government' isn't one user — tax authorities, RoC/SEBI and labour departments each want different data. Name the specific department and its exact need.
c12_acc_cbse_01_004: Fixed capital isn't frozen — extra capital brought in or permanently withdrawn still changes the Capital Account. Only routine items go to Current Account.
c11_acc_cbse_01_005: Comparable doesn't mean identical policies — FIFO and weighted average can both be fine. Check that each firm applies its policy consistently and discloses it.
c12_acc_cbse_01_005: Interest on drawings goes on the credit side of P&L Appropriation — it's income to the firm, not an appropriation. Think from the firm's view: the firm receives it.
c11_acc_cbse_01_006: Cost accounting asks 'what did it cost?'; management accounting asks 'what should we do?' Check whether the task is ascertaining cost or making a decision.
c12_acc_cbse_01_006: Interest on capital is an appropriation of profit, not a charge like rent — debit P&L Appropriation, and base it on the capital actually employed during the year.
c11_acc_cbse_01_007: Careful not to mix roles, branches and functions of accounting. Asked for the role? Say what it does for society — not what a branch produces.
c12_acc_cbse_01_007: Don't grab 6.5 months automatically — match the average period to the drawing pattern (quarterly beginning = 7.5). Count full months up to the closing month.
c11_acc_cbse_01_008: Capital isn't a business asset — it's the owner's claim on the business (entity concept). The cash brought in is the asset; check whose claim it represents.
c12_acc_cbse_01_008: A partner's salary isn't an expense — partners are owners, so debit P&L Appropriation, not P&L. Net profit stays unchanged; only divisible profit falls.
c11_acc_cbse_01_009: Look at the source, not the cash direction: revenue and expenses come from ordinary operations, while gains and losses come from incidental events.
c12_acc_cbse_01_009: A profit guarantee doesn't increase total profit — it redistributes the same profit, and the shortfall comes out of the guaranteeing partners' shares.
c11_acc_cbse_01_010: Money leaving the business isn't always an expense — a proprietor's personal withdrawal is Drawings. Debit Drawings, credit Cash, and keep expenses clean.
c12_acc_cbse_01_010: Don't push past-period fixes through this year's P&L — use a P&L Adjustment Account, then transfer it to capital accounts in the profit-sharing ratio.
c11_acc_cbse_01_011: An owner's withdrawal reduces Capital, not Liabilities — the business owes the owner less; it owes outsiders the same. Check whose claim actually shrank.
c12_acc_cbse_01_011: Even under fixed capital, permanent capital added or withdrawn goes through the Capital Account — 'fixed' only means routine items don't touch it.
c11_acc_cbse_01_012: Limitations don't make accounting unreliable — the profit figure is reliable for what it measures; it just doesn't measure things like morale.
c12_acc_cbse_02_001: Sacrificing ratio equals the old ratio only by default — check how the new partner takes the share; equal slices mean equal sacrifice, not 3:2.
c11_acc_cbse_02_001: GAAP isn't a single rulebook — it's a framework of concepts, conventions and standards. Accounting Standards are the specific rules inside GAAP.
c12_acc_cbse_02_002: Goodwill exists once a firm earns super-normal profits — admission or retirement just triggers its valuation. No cash changing hands doesn't mean no goodwill.
c11_acc_cbse_02_002: The entity concept applies even to a sole proprietor — household rent paid from business cash is Drawings, not a business rent expense.
